title: Air-quality monitoring
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Identify high-emissions periods.
3. Calibrate and verify monitoring equipment.
4. Define the type of pollutants involved.
5. Apply recognized methods for emission quantification.
6. Cross-reference with meteorological data.
7. Ensure emission data is traceable and verifiable.
8. Analyze the data against regulatory standards and thresholds.
9. Compile detailed information on emission sources and processes.
10. Describe any anomalies or potential areas of non-compliance.
11. Include photos, graphs, measurements, and detailed logs.
12. Use multiple sampling points and times to ensure accuracy.
13. Compare emission data with baseline or historical data.
14. Include maintenance records for emission control equipment.
15. Document any observations of visible signs of air quality deterioration.
16. Prepare detailed methodologies and statistical analyses.
17. Attach copies of emission permits and regulatory requirements.
18. Provide a detailed narrative of findings.
19. Review data for internal consistency and external compliance.
20.
